tasks.task_description: Examine RPC runtime infrastructure for broadcast methods
Check WebSocket server implementation for client management
Look for existing broadcast or notification patterns
Determine if server can call RPC on multiple/all clients

description: Analyze RPC system for server-to-all-clients broadcasting capability
context: Examined RpcRuntime.kt - found RpcRegistry and RpcInvoker classes. RpcInvoker has methods for single requests but no broadcast methods. RpcCallContext has notify() methods for sending to individual connections.

Found PlayerConnectionManager with broadcast capabilities! It has broadcast() method for sending RPC messages to all connected clients, and broadcastClients() method for making RPC calls to all clients and collecting responses.

Confirmed the RPC system supports server-to-all-clients broadcasting through PlayerConnectionManager. The system provides both one-way broadcasts and RPC calls with response collection from all clients.
